file: 271 Survive Your Ideas on Roblox Makes Any Word Come to Life.mp4

lines.t: This new fun game on Roblox lets you type any word. And then it actually happens.

full.credit: Clips: Carlforthewin352; the randombloxian; Shawnplayz (Roblox gameplay, YouTube)

sc.big:
THIS NEW FUN
GAME ON ROBLOX

lines.t: Each round, one random player writes a word, and it comes to life. A tsunami. A dinosaur. A nuke. Tacos.

full.credit: Clips: Carlforthewin352; the randombloxian; Shawnplayz (Roblox gameplay, YouTube)

lines.t: The words stack up, the chaos keeps growing, and the last player alive wins.

full.credit: Clips: Carlforthewin352; the randombloxian; Shawnplayz (Roblox gameplay, YouTube)

lines.t: It came out in October, and it already has over 2 million visits.
